activities.name: If Mgmt Pool is Online
activities.description:
Below are the activities executed under this.

If the Pool is online, activities inside will run only when the trigger corresponds to the right maintenance mode

Workspace is not a management workspace 
AND
(It is triggered by MS-driven maintenance and customer has opted-in to stop ETL
OR
It is triggered by Scheduled maintenance to save cost and customer has not be opted-out to stop ETL)

GOAL is, if above conditions are met, STOP all the triggers, and ensure all the running pipelines finished their execution

ifFalseActivities.name: Execute Truncate Trigger State Files
ifFalseActivities.description: Mgmt pool is offline - opt-in/opt-out cannot be checked and nothing gets stopped this cycle for any workspace, so clear every workspace's trigger state file to prevent pl_root_infra_maintenance_end from later restarting triggers based on a stale file left over from an earlier cycle
